//: Example operator config for harness.py and grade.py. Copy it outside the repository, fill every <...>, and keep it with the results. Relative paths are relative to this file. No secret goes in here: name environment variables in agent.pass_env instead.
tasks_dir: <directory written by select_tasks.py draw: holds tasks/ and, after freeze, reference/>

mirrors.<owner/name>: <local mirror of the repository, for example made with git clone --mirror>

work_root: <optional: where working copies are made; default runs_root/work>
model: <the model identifier exactly as the agent is told to use it; recorded in the manifest>

command: <path to the operator's wrapper for the agent under test>
agent.budget: <per-run budget in whatever unit the wrapper enforces, passed through as text>

plain_instructions_dir: <directory of <task id>.md files: the plain generated instructions, one per task, made before any run>

files.src: <the hook configuration for the agent under test, built from integrations/>
files.dest: <where that agent reads project hooks, relative to the repository root>
